text: Electronic Science and Technology is a fundamental and engineering-oriented discipline that studies the movement laws of electrons, the design and manufacture of electronic devices, and the application of electronic systems. From the chips in smart phones to the radars in satellite communications, from the sensors in medical equipment to the electronic control systems in new energy vehicles, electronic science and technology is the "cornerstone" of the modern information society, directly driving innovations in fields such as information technology, intelligent manufacturing, and artificial intelligence.
